summary: Agent-ready steering file for floating terrain: broken continent fragments, geological process first, macro/meso/micro shape hierarchy, accepted rock grammars, forbidden blob patterns, and terrain gameplay checklist.
Routes future agents to the rock shape grammar alongside level-generation and Thunder workflow docs.
Adds project-specific terrain grammar rules so the Hanging Gardens settlement can sit within believable broken geological fragments instead of random floating blobs.
Thunder Brainstorm handoff summarizing durable rock-generation lessons and implementation bias for future terrain generator work.

Build 0.8.174 extends mesh integrity coverage to the active sedimentary island and bridge mesh paths, requiring watertight manifold edges and outward normal winding after diagonal voxel contact cleanup.
Build 0.8.175 adds deterministic shared-vertex sediment shear and erosion offsets to active sedimentary meshes so they stay manifold but no longer read as exact cube-grid kitbash geometry.
